title: On the Structure and Stability of Boundary Mixed Steady States in Evolutionary Games on Networks
summary: We study steady states of evolutionary games on networks in which some players adopt pure strategies while others play mixed strategies. We refer to these configurations as boundary mixed steady states. Such states arise naturally in structured populations and have no counterpart in the classical well-mixed setting. We introduce a relaxed equilibrium notion, called boundary Nash equilibrium, in which the Nash condition is imposed only on non-pure players.
